messages:
Anna (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Hummingbird week0 preflight for the private/VPC deploy. Customer timeline: POC in ~3 weeks. Need short status on networking / IAM / KMS / audit logs + any blockers that might threaten that timeline.
Devin (SE): Quick wins: sent the onboarding templates (VPC, IAM, KMS) earlier. Waiting on their VPC CIDR and whether they want a managed NAT vs egress-only IGW. Also need the AWS account ID for cross-account roles.
Marco (Networking): Blocking: they haven't chosen peering vs transit gateway. If they go TGW we need their attachment account id + route ranges. Also ask Hummingbird: do you have a dedicated /22 available for our endpoints?
Hummingbird Ops: We're finalizing CIDR today, leaning toward /22. For peering we prefer TGW but need cost estimate. We have an existing KMS key in account 987654321000. Audit logs: prefer S3 storage but want <90d retention to save on costs.
Sara (Security): Noted. For KMS cross-account access we'll need to add Redwood's AWS account id (123456789012) in the key policy and allow "kms:Decrypt"/"kms:DescribeKey" for the role. Draft policy snippet below — please confirm principal ARN.
Sara (Security): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-assume"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Devin (SE): For logs we prefer S3 with a prefix `redwood/hummingbird/` and SSE-KMS using their key. We'll need the bucket ARN + a role we can assume: `arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/RedwoodOnboardRole`. Also need their preferred region for log delivery.
Marco (Networking): Firewall rule ask: allow outbound 443 to Redwood egress ranges (we'll provide). If TGW: route table instruction — add a route to 10.10.0.0/16 -> tgw-attach-id. If peering: add peering route and update SGs.
Hummingbird Ops: Can we get the exact egress ranges? Also TGW cost is ok if it shortens setup time. We can confirm role ARN by EOD.
Anna (CSM): Heads-up: Sales flagged this account as mid-renewal risk if POC slips. They're at ~$85k ARR. Let's prioritize the TGW decision and get the role/bucket today. Also they asked for a simplified onboarding checklist doc — can we surface that in the enablement call?
Devin (SE): I'll prepare a 30-min enablement runbook and share the checklist link in this thread before the call. @Hummingbird Ops — propose Tue 10am PT for enablement?
Hummingbird Ops: Tue 10am PT works. We'll confirm the role ARN and bucket name by EOD.
Sara (Security): Action: I'll prepare the KMS key policy template and a short note about audit retention trade-offs (cost vs compliance) — will post here.
Marco (Networking): Action: I'll send the minimal firewall/IP list and TGW vs peering one-pager. Expect both by tomorrow morning.
Anna (CSM): Action: I'll log renewal risk with Sales and schedule a weekly status check with the customer (Wed standup). Also capturing this as feedback: they want a condensed onboarding checklist — Devin will make that. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-3982: "Hummingbird private deploy - week0 preflight" and scheduled a canary slot for next-wed.
Devin (SE): Quick note — if they cannot provide the role/bucket today we can do a delegated flow using temporary creds, but that adds ~1 day of engineering time. Please try to get those values today.
Hummingbird Ops: Understood. We'll prioritize. Thanks everyone.
Anna (CSM): Closing for now — will follow up after Devin posts the checklist and Marco posts the network plan. If anything urgent ping me directly. :phone:
